audit.why: Akali ahead levels 1-5 and Skill at 6 fits 51.29% Emerald+ over 29 games and matches the mirror file already on disk. Chart untouched; the why text now says which cooldown decides each stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike line pointed at 'Riftwalk cooldown windows' as the thing to trade around.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s. It has no punishable cooldown window at all — his real limiter is mana and Null Sphere's 9s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid, phases[1]/[3]/[5].why and dosFull[0] around Null Sphere's 9s and his mana pool.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early claimed 'you out-range him with Q (Five Point Strike)'.
audit.why: Null Sphere is 650 range; Five Point Strike is 550. Kassadin out-ranges Akali in lane, and Null Sphere both silences and grants him a magic-damage shield.
audit.corrected: content.early and whys[0] now state 650 vs 550 and tell you to step up only on the whiff.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Riftwalk before every engage' was the headline cooldown advice.
audit.why: Unactionable — a 5s ultimate is never down. Null Sphere at 9s is the real window.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0], dosFull[2], tldr, winCon and breakdown.trading rebuilt around Null Sphere.

edits.before: Bully him early — shroud his Riftwalk and burst the gap. Akali wins the Riftwalk cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bully him early — bait Null Sphere, then burst the gap. Akali wins the Null Sphere cooldown windows.

edits.before: Shroud his Riftwalk and burst the gap. Track Riftwalk before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Bait Null Sphere and burst the gap. Track its 9s rank-1 cooldown before every commit and hold the wave your side.

edits.before: Kassadin wins by landing Riftwalk, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Kassadin wins by silencing your combo with Null Sphere, then out-scaling into Riftwalk range.

edits.before: Q Kassadin at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Bait Null Sphere from outside its 650 range, E-dash in on the whiff, and shroud the return fire.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kassadin Null Sphere: matchup-defining — 9s at rank 1, silences your combo and shields him against your magic burst. Step up on the whiff. - Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1: track his mana, not its cooldown. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Riftwalk: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around Null Sphere: in the 9s after it whiffs, run your full pattern; while it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.

edits.before: Good trade: Q Kassadin at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire. Great trade: Kassadin wastes Riftwalk — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Good trade: bait Null Sphere from outside its 650 range, E-dash in on the whiff, and shroud the return fire. Great trade: Kassadin whiffs Null Sphere — 9 silence-free seconds, commit the full pattern. Bad trade: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Kassadin's Riftwalk is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only step up in the 9s after Null Sphere misses.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Riftwalk's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: trade in the 9s after Null Sphere whiffs and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Riftwalk's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on a whiffed Null Sphere.

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk before you commit
edits.after: Track Kassadin's Null Sphere before you commit

edits.before: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 9s at rank 1; it silences your combo and shields him. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Kassadin wastes Riftwalk — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Kassadin whiffs Null Sphere — commit the full pattern immediately.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are a shove-and-deny phase, not a kill phase. Kassadin is melee with no Riftwalk yet, so you out-range him with Q (Five Point Strike), but his Null Sphere silences you mid-combo and his passive shield blunts a chunk of your magic damage, so a greedy all-in just trades into nothing. Throw max-range Q to chip and deny CS, walk your Assassin's Mark ring for the empowered-auto poke, and do not waste E chasing — whiff it and you are silenced and powerless. The goal is to keep him off his farm and reach your level-6 spike even or ahead.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are a shove-and-deny phase, not a kill phase. Kassadin is melee with no Riftwalk yet, but Null Sphere reaches 650 against your Q's 550, so he wins the poke war and a greedy all-in trades into nothing — his passive blunts a chunk of your magic damage too. Chip with max-range Q in the 9 seconds after his Q whiffs, walk your Assassin's Mark ring for the empowered-auto poke, and do not waste E chasing — whiff it and you are silenced and powerless. The goal is to keep him off his farm and reach your level-6 spike even or ahead.

edits.before: You only have Q and no Shroud, and his Null Sphere can silence your one spell — neither of you wins level 1, so just deny his last-hits.
edits.after: His Null Sphere reaches 650 to your Q's 550 and can silence your one spell — neither of you wins level 1, so just deny his last-hits.

notes: Riftwalk's cooldown is 5/3.5/2s, so all 'engage on Riftwalk's cooldown' advice across this file was unactionable; the real tracked cooldown is Null Sphere (9s rank 1) plus his mana. Also: Akali's Assassin's Mark does NOT heal — Riot's text gives only bonus range and damage. That fabrication appears in other Akali matchup files (kayle whys[0]) and is fixed there too.
